note: This is NOT a codex-amendment-request and carries no execution authority. It presents measured registry-vs-source divergence in gptbridge_codex.sql_migration_registry / sql_migration_authority_registry and asks the governor to disposition each class. No registry row is modified by this artifact.
subject: Migration registry reconciliation: 15 source-hash mismatches, 4 rows pointing to deleted files, 89 unregistered on-disk migrations
evidence_sources: live PostgreSQL read-only measurement: gptbridge_codex.sql_migration_registry (50 rows = 1 genesis + 49 ordered-source-verified), gptbridge_codex.sql_migration_authority_registry (49 rows ordered-source-verified)

decisions.finding: 15 registered migrations have migration_source_hash (and sql_migration_authority_registry.source_hash) values that no longer equal the SHA-256 of the current file bytes. Every one of the 15 files was last modified on 2026-09-26 by commit e487bc473 ('vectord renames, pg-sole-authority migrations') and/or 99ba911f3 ('retire residual Qdrant/SQLite semantics across source, migrations, tests, and codex registries'; its message states 'Repair migration defects found by full-replay validation (008, 019, 030, 035, 055, 134, 138, 029/031 seed names); 133/133 migrations replay clean'). These are post-registration semantic repairs: the current files are the corrected versions.
decisions.proposed_resolution: governed RESTAMP of migration_source_hash (and the sql_migration_authority_registry.source_hash twin) to the measured current file SHA-256 for each listed sequence. Files must NOT be reverted to match stale registry hashes.
decisions.must_not_do: do not revert file content; do not delete or reorder registry rows; restamp preserves sequence and chain order

decisions.finding: 4 registered sequences point to source files that no longer exist on disk. All four were intentionally deleted on 2026-09-26 by commit 26c63f79e ('retire sqlite/qdrant artifacts: drop obsolete engines, migrations, retire module names'), part of the Qdrant/SQLite production retirement. Each row is currently status=ordered-source-verified in both sql_migration_registry (MIG_PG_000025/37/45/46) and sql_migration_authority_registry (025_sqlite_generation_fence / 037_sqlite_classification / 045_sqlite_template_release / 046_qdrant_contract_version).
decisions.proposed_resolution: governed RETIREMENT of the 4 registry rows (and their sql_migration_authority_registry twins) to a retired status; the files must NOT be recreated (a recreated file could never match the registered hash and would resurrect retired sqlite/qdrant semantics).
decisions.must_not_do: do not recreate the deleted .sql files; do not reuse the freed sequence numbers for new migrations
decisions.note: Commit 26c63f79e also deleted 13 further migration files (053/054/067/068/079/080/099/101/102/103/104/126/132) that were never registered, so they carry no registry cleanup obligation.

decisions.finding: 89 .sql files exist under shared-layer/migrations/ with no row in sql_migration_registry (registered basenames are 001-024, 026-036, 038-044, 047-049 = 45 files; 134 on disk total). Each needs a per-file governor disposition.
decisions.proposed_resolution: per-file governed decision: REGISTER (assign next ordered sequence, stamp source hash, join the ordered chain), RETIRE (mark file non-authoritative), or SUPERSEDE (fold into an existing or new registered migration). Duplicate-numbered pairs (087_*, 088_*) require explicit ordering or supersede resolution first.
decisions.must_not_do: do not execute unregistered files; do not let the executor chain skip sequences silently; duplicate sequence prefixes must not both register

advisory_open_questions_not_decisions_he: target_schema_hash recipe: executor measures live manifest via OBJECT_MANIFEST_V1 but registered target_schema_hash values were stamped under a different governor-side recipe - governor must publish the recipe or authorize a restamp of the hash chain before the chain can execute

machine_schema_registry parity: 77 PENDING rows; proposal codex-amendment-proposal-machine-schema-parity-restamp-20260924 is staged; its referenced extractor toolchain was retired with the Python lane
blocking_context: until MIG-REG-A and MIG-REG-B are dispositioned the ordered chain cannot execute (registry-hash verification is fail-closed); until MIG-REG-C is dispositioned the live catalog keeps diverging from declared migration state (probe: 709 declared objects missing live, 522 live-only objects)

verification.method: SHA-256 of current file bytes vs sql_migration_registry.migration_source_hash for every registered forward_identity; Test-Path per registered file; registry-vs-disk basename diff for unregistered set; git show --stat / git log --follow for commit attribution
verification.reproducibility: deterministic; measurement performed 2026-10-02 against the live database and the working tree
